periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree downward diagonal orientation towards the muzzle relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval or teardrop profile with a longitudinal axis significantly greater than its width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering effect, with the lowest point extending substantially below the geometric center of the eye patch.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Significant thickness, covering approximately one-third of the visible vertical height of the lateral torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The gap between the dark ear regions is approximately equal to the transverse width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: High smoothness with a consistent semi-circular curvature at the superior boundary of the ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent brownish-red soil staining on the ventral fur in the lower abdominal region.
